o1.biggest_strength: It finds the three real levers in the data: courier-silence WISMO tickets, low fit finder use on bras, and a refund-biased returns portal.
o1.biggest_mistake: The day-3 update is weaker than it should be because it only goes to scanned parcels, even though the biggest silence problem is before the courier scan, and it misses a dedicated post-delivery bra fit follow-up.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add a proper first-time bra post-delivery fit message, send the day-3 reassurance even when tracking is quiet, and tighten the swap-sales estimate so it is less ceiling-led.

o2.biggest_strength: It turns the data into a practical flow: stop the delivery silence first, push first-time bra buyers into fit help, and make size swaps easier than refunds without hiding refunds.
o2.biggest_mistake: It assumes some operational extras, especially the 2-hour size switch, SMS, and free swap wording, that would need confirming before launch.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Keep the same plan but mark the operationally uncertain pieces as fallbacks and soften any copy that may over-encourage swaps after delivery.

reason: Both are strong and usable, but Output 2 gives the fuller message journey, including a pre-dispatch fit check and post-delivery bra fit follow-up, while keeping the numbers cleaner and easier to track.
